slides.title: Closing Knowledge Gaps, Not Selling
bullets: Closes knowledge gaps in the clinical community through non-promotional activities
Covers disease understanding, mechanism of action, diagnostics, appropriate use
One of three tactical vehicles, alongside the publication and congress plans

slides.title: Identifying Educational Gaps
bullets: MSL-collected insights from the field
Formal surveys of healthcare professionals
Recurring questions observed at congresses
Utilization data suggesting suboptimal use driven by lack of knowledge

slides.title: Four Channels for Medical Education
bullets: Accredited CME/CPD programs for institutional credibility and broad reach
Webinars and virtual sessions for dispersed audiences at lower cost
Satellite symposia that leverage concentrated congress audiences
Digital asynchronous content: videos, infographics, e-learning platforms

slides.title: Independence from Promotional Content
bullets: Must be based on balanced evidence, including limitations and alternatives
Designed and supervised by medical and scientific professionals, not Commercial
Follows the same non-promotional principles as all Medical Affairs communication
Often explicitly regulated, with accreditation and funding transparency rules

slides.title: A Role in Design, Delivery, and Sometimes the Podium
bullets: Identify concrete training needs in your own territory
Connect expert speakers with the organizers of educational activities
Occasionally contribute as a speaker within the non-promotional framework

slides.title: Measuring Impact Beyond Attendance
bullets: Attendance figures alone don't show whether the activity changed anything
The real goal is a measurable change in understanding or clinical practice
This measurement challenge is picked up in this module's KPI lesson

takeaway.title: The medical education plan closes clinical knowledge gaps through non-promotional formats
bullets: It starts from identified educational, not scientific, gaps
Format choice depends on audience reach, cost, and accreditation needs
Its independence from promotional content is strict and often regulated
